about: check:copy's allow-list (v16.6; review round 1). Each entry allows exactly `count` text units of `file` (each keyed by its position) that contain `text` (equal it, with `exact`; inside the declaration `within`; inside one of `deadFunctions`), for the listed gate words; a new occurrence or a stale entry fails. `dom.scope` (a CSS selector) is where the DOM gate may use the entry, and only there (`dom.match: exact` compares the whole text); entries without it are the static gate's only. `scope: dom` entries are the DOM gate's alone (text built at run time). Kinds: negation, statement-tradition, brand, self-report, guide, score-name, work-title, data, dead. taggedData lists every declaration whose rows carry a tag (T2), the components that show it with its tag (renderers) and those that show its names bare, each with a reason (guard 5). Everything else is rewritten or tagged (spec v16.6 §3), and every flagged unit that passes is listed in scripts/copy-manifest.json.
